featured_reviews.review_text:
Always reliable! One of the best printers in my opinion for anything and everything that stationery you'd need. Though the guys there seem like they have some attitude that's probably only cause they're busy. Stay with them for a few more minutes though and you'll be pleasantly surprised with their service.

Additionally, Gprint also offers very reasonable rates often cheaper than most printers with better quality too.

Overall, great place to get your printing done and if it weren't for the behavioral issues they'd get a whole 5/5!

When I asked why, I was told it’s because they “used their internet” to download it. I don’t know what kind of internet plan justifies ₹50 for a few KBs of data, but even 1.5GB data plans don’t cost that much these days.

👎 No price list displayed for such basic services
👎 Felt taken advantage of, especially when no prior estimate was given

To anyone visiting: always ask the price first
